what: CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING is set immediately after deferred rebase, before post-rebase re-verify
scenario_or_breakage: _verify_failed_jobs_locally ends with exit 3 on ci-local-unfixable (scripts/ship-pr.sh:2125), not a return code. After a deferred rebase the flag can already be true while the process exits 3 with a rebased unpushed tree. A later _stage_and_push can force-with-lease via the pending flag without a successful post-rebase verify/lint gate
suggested_fix: Set CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING only when post-rebase _verify_failed_jobs_locally / run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop fail with return codes (e.g. 4 / 1), not unconditionally after run_rebase_rebump; rely on rebase happened this call for the success-path force push; clear the flag on exit 3 or do not set it until a failed return path
